Package com.lucaf.robotic_core.impl

Class ScaleInterface

java.lang.Object
com.lucaf.robotic_core.impl.SensorInterface
com.lucaf.robotic_core.impl.ScaleInterface
Direct Known Subclasses:
PCB_3, PLJ_1200
public abstract class ScaleInterface extends SensorInterface
Abstract base class for weighing scales (bilance).

A scale exposes a fixed set of operations:

  • initialize() — checks the connection
  • tare() — tares (zeroes) the scale
  • read() — actively reads the current weight
  • enableEventReading() / disableEventReading() — toggles the continuous stream of readings pushed by the scale to the Consumers registered as reading listeners

Concrete scales implement the actual I/O by talking through the IOInterface passed in the constructor. Subclasses must report the readings they receive (from polling or from the stream) by calling emitReading(ScaleResponse) so that registered listeners and getLastReading() stay up to date.

    • readStable

      public ScaleResponse readStable() throws IOException
      Actively reads the current stable (settled) weight from the scale.

      By default this is equivalent to read(), since not every scale distinguishes stable from unstable readings. Scales that expose a dedicated stable-reading command should override this method (e.g. the KERN PCB uses "s" for stable versus "w" for stable-or-unstable).

      Returns:
      the current stable weight expressed in #getUnit()
      Throws:
      IOException - if the reading cannot be retrieved
